{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm since we need it for the mean
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Group by species and compute mean flipper length
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order and get the top species
top_species = mean_flipper_by_species.loc[mean_flipper_by_species['flipper_length_mm'].idxmax()]['species']

mean_flipper_by_species, top_species"}
